My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
If your item arrived damaged, please initiate an EXCHANGE REQUEST THROUGH THE RETURN PORTAL and select the appropriate return reason.
You’ll be asked to provide:
- a brief description of the damaged item
- a photo of the item
- a photo of the care tag located on the inside of the garment
If your request is approved, you’ll receive an email with a PREPAID LABEL.
I also found that ONLY ITEMS RECEIVED DAMAGED OR INCORRECT ARE ELIGIBLE FOR AN EXCHANGE, and the exchange can only be for the SAME STYLE.
If you want help with your specific order, please log in so I can guide you further.
